summary: Backend-only comprehensive test of WiseDemo v2 (fresh build). All 10 pytest tests pass (100%): health, URL validation (empty/whitespace/non-URL/short → 400/422), valid job creation, single job GET, unknown job 404, list jobs, video-before-ready 404, and full live pipeline e2e (scrape → Gemini analyze → Gemini plan → Steel record → HLS→MP4 → OpenAI TTS → ffmpeg compose). End-to-end job (https://vercel.com) reached status='ready', progress=100, product.product_name/tagline/top_features populated, video MP4 served with Content-Type video/mp4, body > 200KB, and ?download=1 returns Content-Disposition: attachment header. Duration was within [30,70]s. E2E took ~82s and full suite ~166s.

minor.issue: Steel SDK calls client.sessions.create() and client.sessions.release() are SYNCHRONOUS and executed on the asyncio event loop inside record_tour(). While a pipeline runs, incoming HTTP requests (e.g. POST /api/jobs, GET /api/jobs/{id}) can be blocked for several seconds, causing client-side timeouts (observed 15s ReadTimeout under load). Wrap sync Steel SDK calls with asyncio.to_thread() to keep the loop responsive.

Running uvicorn with --reload in production-like preview causes any file write under /app/backend (including tests) to kill in-progress background pipeline tasks (fire-and-forget asyncio tasks). Consider disabling --reload or moving tests outside /app/backend. Tests were relocated to /app/tests/ to work around this.

URL validation regex accepts strings like 'abc.def' (4+ chars, no whitespace) that aren't real URLs. Not blocking today because Pydantic min_length + downstream scraper eventually errors; consider stricter validation (require domain + TLD).
Returns 404 both for 'job not found' and 'video not ready' — same status/detail. Consider distinguishing with 409 or clearer detail messages for API consumers.

action_items: Wrap synchronous Steel SDK calls (client.sessions.create/release) with asyncio.to_thread() in /app/backend/services/steel_service.py so the event loop is not blocked while a pipeline runs.
Optional: disable uvicorn --reload in supervisor config to prevent in-flight pipelines from being killed on any file save.
Optional: differentiate 'job not found' vs 'video not ready' response codes/messages in GET /api/jobs/{id}/video.
critical_code_review_comments: steel_service.record_tour: `client.sessions.create()` and `client.sessions.release()` are blocking (Steel Python SDK is sync); running them inside an async coroutine blocks the ASGI event loop and degrades API responsiveness for all concurrent clients.

pipeline.run_pipeline: fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task means a server restart or code reload silently loses running jobs and leaves them stuck in a non-terminal status forever (no recovery / TTL cleanup).
server._normalize_url regex ^(https?://)?[^\s]{4,}$ is very permissive (accepts 'abc.def', 'abcd'); combined with Pydantic min_length=4 this permits many non-URL strings.
server._to_out uses doc['id'] directly — if a document is ever inserted without 'id', response construction will 500. Consider .get() with fallback.

GET /api/jobs has no pagination or ordering guarantee documented in server.py; ensure db.list_jobs sorts by created_at DESC (couldn't verify without viewing db.py, but tests confirm it returns a list).
